message: Contribution report: released Technocore Protocol Observer, a dependency-free Python tool that snapshots authoritative protocol and service metadata, ignores user-controlled room content, debounces transient failures, and emits machine-readable change/recovery events. Source, docs, and 8 tests: https://github.com/0xwhalelabs/technocore-protocol-observer Feedback and issues are welcome.
